title: Suffixes 2
note: B2 WF unit, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. House style cloned from b2_prefixes_1 / b1_suffixes. Tranche above b1_suffixes' core set (-er/-tion/-ment/-ness/-ful/-less/-able/-ous/-al/-ly): -ity / -ance / -ence / -ship / -hood / -dom, per B2-PLAN, plus **-cy** as the seventh map tile — the plan names six and DRAFTING.md's WF shape wants seven; -cy (fluent -> fluency, efficient -> efficiency) is the natural sibling of -ity/-ance in the abstract-noun set. Logged in DECISIONS.md. EVERY ROOT WAS SWEPT before use, per the DRAFTING.md rule that sank six roots in Prefixes 2: able, safe, secure, equal, appear, insure, assist, silent, exist, relation, bore, accurate, private and urgent all came back untaught and were dropped; only roots already in the pool survive. Distractors are the same root carrying a wrong suffix from this unit's own set (B6 same-axis, B1 clearly wrong, B4 the unit's own error is on the board). Use is error-correction on the adjective-for-noun slip, which is the real Czech learner error here (*a big different*, *his responsible*, *with real confident*) — E7/E9 satisfied because every prompt carries a genuine error.

cards.title: Suffixes 2
points: Suffixes 1 built people and qualities: teach**er**, kind**ness**, care**ful**.
This set builds **abstract nouns** — the quality, the state, the bond itself.

cards.title: The quality itself
points: **-ity**, **-ance** and **-ence** turn an adjective or a verb into the thing.
The adjective can never do this job on its own.

cards.title: A bond, a position, a time of life
points: **-ship** makes the bond or the role — never the person.
**-hood** makes the time or state of life.

cards.title: A condition and a skill
points: **-dom** names a condition you are in, or a realm.
**-cy** names a quality or a skill.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: The commonest slip is using the adjective where English needs the noun.

items.en: -ity
items.cz: vlastnost · the quality of being

items.en: -ance
items.cz: stav nebo děj · a state or an action

items.en: -ence
items.cz: stav nebo děj · a state or an action

items.en: -ship
items.cz: vztah nebo postavení · a bond or a position

items.en: -hood
items.cz: doba nebo stav života · a time or state of life

items.en: -dom
items.cz: stav nebo oblast · a condition or a realm

items.en: -cy
items.cz: vlastnost nebo dovednost · a quality or a skill

items.en: There is a real possibility of rain tomorrow.
items.cz: Zítra je reálná možnost deště.
items.gap: There is a real ____ of rain tomorrow. (POSSIBLE)
accepts: There is a real possibility of rain tomorrow.
items.explanation: **-ity** turns the adjective *possible* into the thing itself.
items.explanation_cz: **-ity** mění přídavné jméno *possible* na věc samotnou.

items.en: Checking the files is his responsibility now.
items.cz: Kontrola těch souborů je teď jeho odpovědnost.
items.gap: Checking the files is his ____ now. (RESPONSIBLE)
accepts: Checking the files is his responsibility now.
items.explanation: **-ity**: *responsible* is what he is, **responsibility** is what he has.
items.explanation_cz: **-ity**: *responsible* je jaký je, **responsibility** je co má.

items.en: Swimming is her favourite activity after work.
items.cz: Plavání je její oblíbená aktivita po práci.
items.gap: Swimming is her favourite ____ after work. (ACTIVE)
accepts: Swimming is her favourite activity after work.
items.explanation: **-ity**: from *active* to the thing you do.

items.en: Nobody understood the importance of that decision.
items.cz: Nikdo nechápal důležitost toho rozhodnutí.
items.gap: Nobody understood the ____ of that decision. (IMPORTANT)
accepts: Nobody understood the importance of that decision.
items.explanation: **-ance** after *important* — the quality itself.

items.en: Her performance in the play was wonderful.
items.cz: Její výkon v té hře byl skvělý.
items.gap: Her ____ in the play was wonderful. (PERFORM)
accepts: Her performance in the play was wonderful.
items.explanation: **-ance** turns the verb *perform* into the event.

items.en: There is a big difference between the two.
items.cz: Mezi těmi dvěma je velký rozdíl.
items.gap: There is a big ____ between the two. (DIFFERENT)
accepts: There is a big difference between the two.
items.explanation: **-ence**, not *different*: the adjective cannot be the noun.
items.explanation_cz: **-ence**, ne *different*: přídavné jméno nemůže být podstatné.

items.en: He answered every question with real confidence.
items.cz: Na každou otázku odpověděl s opravdovou jistotou.
items.gap: He answered every question with real ____. (CONFIDENT)
accepts: He answered every question with real confidence.
items.explanation: **-ence**: *confident* is how he feels, **confidence** is the thing.
items.explanation_cz: **-ence**: *confident* je jak se cítí, **confidence** je ta věc.

items.en: Their friendship started at school many years ago.
items.cz: Jejich přátelství začalo ve škole před mnoha lety.
items.gap: Their ____ started at school many years ago. (FRIEND)
accepts: Their friendship started at school many years ago.
items.explanation: **-ship** makes the bond between people, not the person.
items.explanation_cz: **-ship** dělá pouto mezi lidmi, ne osobu.

items.en: My membership of the club ends in June.
items.cz: Moje členství v tom klubu končí v červnu.
items.gap: My ____ of the club ends in June. (MEMBER)
accepts: My membership of the club ends in June.
items.explanation: **-ship**: a *member* is a person, **membership** is the position.

items.en: She spent her childhood in a small village.
items.cz: Dětství strávila v malé vesnici.
items.gap: She spent her ____ in a small village. (CHILD)
accepts: She spent her childhood in a small village.
items.explanation: **-hood** makes the time of life, not the person.

items.en: Every country needs the freedom to speak.
items.cz: Každá země potřebuje svobodu mluvit.
items.gap: Every country needs the ____ to speak. (FREE)
accepts: Every country needs the freedom to speak.
items.explanation: **-dom** turns *free* into the condition of being free.

items.en: His fluency in English surprised everybody.
items.cz: Jeho plynulost v angličtině všechny překvapila.
items.gap: His ____ in English surprised everybody. (FLUENT)
accepts: His fluency in English surprised everybody.
items.explanation: **-cy** after *fluent* — the skill itself.

items.en: The reality was worse than the story.
items.cz: Skutečnost byla horší než ten příběh.
items.gap: The ____ was worse than the story. (REAL)
accepts: The reality was worse than the story.
items.explanation: **-ity**: from *real* to the thing that is real.
items.explanation_cz: **-ity**: z *real* na to, co je skutečné.

items.en: There is a strong similarity between the brothers.
items.cz: Mezi těmi bratry je silná podobnost.
items.gap: There is a strong ____ between the brothers. (SIMILAR)
accepts: There is a strong similarity between the brothers.
items.explanation: **-ity** after *similar* — the quality itself.

items.en: The popularity of the show keeps growing.
items.cz: Popularita toho pořadu stále roste.
items.gap: The ____ of the show keeps growing. (POPULAR)
accepts: The popularity of the show keeps growing.
items.explanation: **-ity**: *popular* describes it, **popularity** is the thing.

items.en: The distance between the towns is thirty kilometres.
items.cz: Vzdálenost mezi těmi městy je třicet kilometrů.
items.gap: The ____ between the towns is thirty kilometres. (DISTANT)
accepts: The distance between the towns is thirty kilometres.
items.explanation: **-ance** after *distant* — how far it is.

items.en: Her acceptance of the offer surprised everyone.
items.cz: Její přijetí té nabídky všechny překvapilo.
items.gap: Her ____ of the offer surprised everyone. (ACCEPT)
accepts: Her acceptance of the offer surprised everyone.
items.explanation: **-ance** turns the verb *accept* into the act.

items.en: Teaching young children needs great patience.
items.cz: Učit malé děti vyžaduje velkou trpělivost.
items.gap: Teaching young children needs great ____. (PATIENT)
accepts: Teaching young children needs great patience.
items.explanation: **-ence**: *patient* is how you are, **patience** is what you need.
items.explanation_cz: **-ence**: *patient* je jaký jsi, **patience** je co potřebuješ.

items.en: Please tell me your preference before Friday.
items.cz: Řekni mi prosím svou preferenci před pátkem.
items.gap: Please tell me your ____ before Friday. (PREFER)
accepts: Please tell me your preference before Friday.
items.explanation: **-ence** turns the verb *prefer* into the choice.

items.en: The country won its independence many years ago.
items.cz: Ta země získala nezávislost před mnoha lety.
items.gap: The country won its ____ many years ago. (INDEPENDENT)
accepts: The country won its independence many years ago.
items.explanation: **-ence** after *independent* — the state itself.

items.en: The team needs better leadership this year.
items.cz: Ten tým letos potřebuje lepší vedení.
items.gap: The team needs better ____ this year. (LEADER)
accepts: The team needs better leadership this year.
items.explanation: **-ship**: a *leader* is a person, **leadership** is the job.

items.en: They started a partnership twenty years ago.
items.cz: Partnerství založili před dvaceti lety.
items.gap: They started a ____ twenty years ago. (PARTNER)
accepts: They started a partnership twenty years ago.
items.explanation: **-ship** makes the bond, not the person.

items.en: We moved to a quieter neighbourhood last spring.
items.cz: Loni na jaře jsme se přestěhovali do klidnější čtvrti.
items.gap: We moved to a quieter ____ last spring. (NEIGHBOUR)
accepts: We moved to a quieter neighbourhood last spring.
items.explanation: **-hood** makes the place, not the person next door.

items.en: The old man spoke with great wisdom.
items.cz: Ten starý muž mluvil s velkou moudrostí.
items.gap: The old man spoke with great ____. (WISE)
accepts: The old man spoke with great wisdom.
items.explanation: **-dom** turns *wise* into the quality.

items.en: Checking the files is his responsibility now.
items.cz: Kontrola těch souborů je teď jeho odpovědnost.
items.wrong: Checking the files is his responsible now.
accepts: Checking the files is his responsibility now.
items.explanation: *Responsible* is the adjective. The noun is **responsibility**.
items.explanation_cz: *Responsible* je přídavné jméno. Podstatné jméno je **responsibility**.

items.en: There is a big difference between the two.
items.cz: Mezi těmi dvěma je velký rozdíl.
items.wrong: There is a big different between the two.
accepts: There is a big difference between the two.
items.explanation: *Different* describes; **difference** is the thing itself.

items.en: His fluency in English surprised everybody.
items.cz: Jeho plynulost v angličtině všechny překvapila.
items.wrong: His fluent in English surprised everybody.
accepts: His fluency in English surprised everybody.
items.explanation: *Fluent* is the adjective. The skill is **fluency**.
items.explanation_cz: *Fluent* je přídavné jméno. Ta dovednost je **fluency**.

items.en: We moved to a quieter neighbourhood last spring.
items.cz: Loni na jaře jsme se přestěhovali do klidnější čtvrti.
items.wrong: We moved to a quieter neighbour last spring.
accepts: We moved to a quieter neighbourhood last spring.
items.explanation: A *neighbour* is a person. The place is the **neighbourhood**.

items.en: Every country needs the freedom to speak.
items.cz: Každá země potřebuje svobodu mluvit.
items.wrong: Every country needs the free to speak.
accepts: Every country needs the freedom to speak.
items.explanation: *Free* is the adjective. The condition is **freedom**.
items.explanation_cz: *Free* je přídavné jméno. Ten stav je **freedom**.

items.en: He answered every question with real confidence.
items.cz: Na každou otázku odpověděl s opravdovou jistotou.
items.wrong: He answered every question with real confident.
accepts: He answered every question with real confidence.
items.explanation: *Confident* is how he feels. The noun is **confidence**.
items.explanation_cz: *Confident* je jak se cítí. Podstatné jméno je **confidence**.
